headline: Strategic Bases Trade Hands Across Six Fronts
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the pace of base turnover has sharpened in the busiest theatres. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest sector, now tallying 162,832 Colonial and 179,818 Warden dead with fourteen ownership changes in the past day; both casualty streams and enlistments are accelerating. Linn Mercy continues to drive heavy fighting around Lathair and Rotdust, logging twenty‑seven flips, 51,246 Colonial and 63,708 Warden casualties, while recruitment surges. Stonecradle’s activity has risen to seventeen flips, Colonial losses at 45,086 and Warden at 54,697, with casualties and sign‑ups both accelerating. Stlican Shelf reports six flips, casualties climbing to 51,780 Colonial and 57,411 Warden, and accelerating loss and enlistment trends. Mooring County holds at eight flips but shows a steep 24‑hour rise of 1,008 Colonial and 821 Warden dead, with enlistments accelerating. Deadlands adds five flips, its 24‑hour toll reaching 3,605 Colonial and 6,989 Warden dead. Fishermans Row’s earlier surge has eased to three flips centered on Oceanwatch. Quiet northern Warden‑held sectors and deep Colonial interiors report no ownership changes.
